$comment: The makesoftware/casper-nctl image tags the e2e matrix is pinned to, and the
build_version each one actually serves. The two do not agree: every v2xx tag
so far reports one patch below its own name (v212 -> 2.1.1). buildVersion is
therefore recorded by booting the image and reading info_get_status, never
derived from the tag string — scripts/check-node-version-drift.js compares
live mainnet/testnet against these numbers, and a tag-derived guess would
Keep this list in step with the matrix in .github/workflows/scheduled-e2e.yml.
